matching.title: Match the financial term to its meaning

meanings.text: Money moving in and out of a business
Percentage of revenue that becomes profit
A recurring cost that doesn't change

matching.feedback: Think about what flows, what stays constant, and what measures profit.
matching.answerOverlay:
After 3 attempts, here's the answer:

Question: Match financial terms with their definitions.

Correct Matches:
• "Invoice" → "A document requesting payment" - An invoice is the formal record sent to request payment for goods or services
• "Cash Flow" → "Money moving in and out of a business" - Cash flow tracks the actual movement of funds over time
• "Fixed Expense" → "A recurring cost that doesn't change" - Fixed expenses like rent remain constant month to month
• "Profit Margin" → "Percentage of revenue that becomes profit" - This ratio shows how much of your income becomes actual profit

Understanding these terms is essential for financial literacy!
matching.completeMessage: You've successfully matched all the financial terms with their meanings!
matching.completeAfterDialogue: Well done! Return to Ms. Amina.

fillGap.instruction: Fill in the blanks to complete the sentence:
fillGap.sentence: To stay financially healthy, it is essential to (___) expenses, plan for (___), and keep a clear record of all (___).
fillGap.placeholderText: Click words on the left to fill in the blanks.
fillGap.feedback: Financial management is never based on ignoring or guessing.
fillGap.answerOverlay:
After 3 attempts, here's the answer:

Question: To stay financially healthy, it is essential to (___) expenses, plan for (___), and keep a clear record of all (___).

Correct Answer:
• First blank: "track" - You must monitor and record where your money goes to maintain control
• Second blank: "emergencies" - Planning ahead for unexpected situations builds financial security
• Third blank: "transactions" - Keeping clear records of all financial activities enables informed decision-making

Complete sentence: "To stay financially healthy, it is essential to track expenses, plan for emergencies, and keep a clear record of all transactions."

Remember: Financial management is never based on ignoring or guessing!
